intro: Our Alina wardrobe brings smart, adaptable storage to your bedroom. With flexible space, secure drawers, and a rich wood finish, it keeps your essentials organised and always within reach.

features.title: Warm wood finish that elevates your space
features.text: Finished in rich walnut, our wardrobe adds warmth to your bedroom — blending functional storage with timeless style.

features.title: Safe storage for valuables
features.text: A lockable drawer keeps important documents, jewellery or personal keepsakes secure — adding peace of mind to everyday storage.

features.title: Spacious storage that adapts to you
features.text: With non-partitioned hanging space and adjustable shelves, Alina gives you the freedom to organise your wardrobe your way — no matter how your needs change.

features.title: Flexible shelves that fit your life
features.text: The adjustable shelf adapts to your changing needs, whether you need more space for folded clothes, accessories or seasonal essentials.

features.title: Built strong for everyday use
features.text: Crafted from durable 15mm prelaminated panels, our wardrobe handles daily wear while keeping your essentials safe, organised, and easy to access.

care: Wipe your wooden almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
